result.title: Sensorium: An Open-Source Multimodal Data Collection and Curation Library for Embodied Surgical AI
result.comment: GenAI for Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026, Sydney
result.summary: Embodied surgical AI requires reliable multimodal data, yet surgical data collection remains costly, difficult to repeat, and strongly dependent on the hardware setup. We present Sensorium, an open-source Python library for recording, processing, annotating, and curating multimodal surgical data from configurable robot and sensor streams using the Robot Operating System (ROS) and ROS2 middleware. The library combines operator-facing data acquisition, configurable processing, semantic annotation, and episodic dataset generation. We evaluate Sensorium across 1516 recordings of phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo porcine experiments involving multiple surgical tasks and sensing configurations, and report preliminary usability feedback.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出开源 Python 库 Sensorium，用于在 ROS/ROS2 下采集、处理、标注与整理多模态手术机器人数据，并在 1516 段活体与离体实验记录上评估其可用性。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作重点是多模态数据的采集与整理基础设施，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或 latent 表示与决策，也未给出可供核查的状态更新或训练监督线索，故与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
